About these numbers. Counted at our origin server and aggregated before publication. No IP addresses, user agents, referrers or file paths ever reach this page — the service that renders it has no access to them, and this page loads nothing from any third party. Countries, edge locations and folders are only named once at least 3 different visitors were seen; everything else is folded into “other”. Cached hits served by Cloudflare never reach the origin, so edge totals are shown separately where available.
